en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a town with a long multi‑span bridge crossing a river filled with floating logs from timber rafting. On the far riverbank stand various buildings, including larger masonry houses and a church with a tall steeple, with forested hills in the background. In the lower right corner, white text identifies the scene, publisher, and date.
